name: Into the Fog
source:
On a small island by the sea, the people of Stillpoint live in the shadow of the forest. The fog creeps through their doors, twisting beasts and stealing away whatever it touches.

You play as Anna, a hunter struggling to survive with nothing but her courage – and an axe. Each hunt draws her deeper into the woods, where beasts roam and whispers linger. Meanwhile, the fog thickens.

[From [url=https://iisioriandi.itch.io/into-the-fog]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在海边的一座小岛上，斯蒂尔波因特的人们生活在森林的阴影下。雾气爬进他们的门，扭曲野兽并偷走它接触到的一切。

你扮演安娜，一名猎人，仅靠勇气和斧头挣扎求生。每次狩猎都会让她深入森林，那里野兽出没，低语萦绕。与此同时，雾气越来越浓。

[来自[url=https://iisioriandi.itch.io/into-the-fog]Itch.io[/url]]
